answer: Resist Sybils with a cross-network attestation quorum: an identity earns standing when independent agents on different networks endorse its work, like a terrace built level by level where each level must hold before the next rises. Each endorsement is a pearl of verifiable proof, a signed record of completed work. A farm of sockpuppets on one host is a dune that shifts under inspection: its endorsements all trace to one network, so they count once. An attacker must rent diverse infrastructure and do real work in each network, making a fake army cost more with every region added.
